description: California Power Plants is a dataset listed in State of California open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by California Energy Commission. The power plant locations and characteristics are part of the California Energy Commission’s (CEC) California Energy Infrastructure geospatial data sets. The data is derived from the CEC’s QFER-1304 Power Plant Owner Reporting Database and is updated annually. Coverage: California. The portal files it under the publisher California Energy Commission. Its tags are CAOpenData, California Energy Commission, California Natural Resources Agency, Power Plant, QFER. It offers 11 resource(s) in ARCGIS GEOSERVICES REST API, CSV, GDB, GEOJSON, GPKG. The portal shows 2026-09-30 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-ca-portal.
